sentences.text: ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:103046
Court No. - 47
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11198 of 2024

Applicant :- Prabhat Singh Gautam And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Shubham Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1 .  Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the impugned order dated 17.2.2024 passed by learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ghaziabad in Criminal Revision No. 459 of 2023 as well as cognizance order dated 24.6.2022 passed by the court of Civil Judge (Junior division)/FTC-1 (Crime Against Women), Ghaziabad in Case No. 65322 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act and impugned charge sheet in case crime no. 80 of 2022, under section 498A, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Thana Muradnagar, District Ghaziabad.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ghaziabad
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: D.P. Act, Thana Muradnagar, District Ghaziabad
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of the present application.

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that marriage between applicant and Prabhat Singh Gautam And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150801317/

entities.text: Prabhat Singh Gautam And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: opposite party no. 2 was solemnized on 18.2.2017 and conjugal relationship seized on 24.12.2017.
It is further submitted that opposite party no. 2 is a working employee in Swami Vivekanand Shubharti University, Meerut and is living separately from the applicant since 24.12.20217.

It is further submitted that present F.I.R. has been lodged by opposite party no. 2 on 22.4.2022 after delay of 1581 days wherein investigating officer has submitted the charge sheet against the applicants.
It is further submitted that against the charge sheet dated 24.6.2022, applicant has filed a criminal revision No. 459 of 2023 which was rejected vide order dated 17.2.2024.
No case under Sections 498A, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act is made out against the applicant.
It is submitted that order impugned is perversed and suffers from manifest error of law.

4. Per contra learned Additional Government Advocate opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicants and submitted that the cognizance order has been passed after considering the primary evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record,
the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.

6. However, it is provided that in case the applicants applies for bail within a period of 30 days from today, their application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days or till the applicants surrenders and applies for bail, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.
